note: What a translation IS, in chips somebody reads without reading. The ORDER is part of the rule: a strip read left to right must not be reshuffled between screens, or the eye has to start reading again each time. Silence is a decision, not an omission — a count of zero votes reads as a verdict, a completeness of 100% is the ordinary state, and both stay out. Selection is a rendering decision (a screen may drop a chip it already says another way); the words, the order and the tones are not. Every expectation here is the WHOLE strip, so a chip appearing, disappearing or moving fails the case.

in.is_main: true when this account leads the lineage, false on a branch of somebody else's, null when the question has no answer here
in.branches_waiting: contributions sent to your Main and not settled
in.main_missing: bool: the Main this branch hangs from is no longer on the site
in.completeness: share of what the file met in game that is translated, 0..1
in.finished: the author's own declaration, null when not known
in.accepts_contributions: whether the Main of this lineage takes branches, null when unknown
in.lines_available: how many lines the waiting contributions hold, null when the server did not count
in.origin: {author, lines} when this was forked from another translation
in.main_owner: who leads this lineage, to name them in the Not yours tip
in.main_abandoned: bool: the Main is still there and its owner erased their account
in.branch_frozen: bool: the Main still exists and has closed its contributions
